skills._naming_convention: Skill names are prefixed with deploy.org_prefix at plugin-build time. The substrate provides skill TEMPLATES with {{prefix}} placeholders; the plugin builder substitutes the prefix when packaging. This ensures multiple dbrain deployments coexist in the same Claude Desktop / Cowork session without name collisions.
skills._example: Template: append-evidence → Built: /dent-append-evidence (Dent deploy) or /yc-append-evidence (hypothetical YC deploy)

fm_mcp._note: FileMaker MCP config is org-specific and goes here. Each deploy that uses FM federation fills these in.

_other_orgs_using_dbrain._note: If another org wants to deploy dbrain, they fork this repo, edit deploy.* and fm_mcp.* fields here, set their own org_prefix, and rebuild the plugin bundle. The substrate code in src/ does not change.
